title: Evaluating Verified Autonomy in Quantum Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2609.17439v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable quantum engineering is essential for turning quantum phenomena into practical technologies. As quantum platforms grow in scale and complexity, their characterization and operation require increasing human effort and coordination. Scientific artificial intelligence agents, which can plan experiments, operate instruments, and analyze observations, offer a promising route towards autonomous quantum engineering. Yet whether current agents can perform reliably in this setting has not been systematically established. To fill this gap, we developed Quantum-Harbor, a virtual laboratory that provides a controlled execution environment for agents to interact with quantum systems. This design enables direct verification of both the actions taken and the conclusions drawn. translated_title: 评估量子工程中的经验证的自主性
translated_abstract: 可靠的量子工程对于将量子现象转化为实用技术至关重要。随着量子平台在规模和复杂性上不断增长，其表征与运行需要越来越多的人力投入和协调配合。科学人工智能智能体（能够规划实验、操作仪器并分析观测结果）为实现自主量子工程提供了一条有前景的路径。然而，当前的智能体能否在这一场景下可靠地执行任务尚未得到系统性验证。为填补这一空白，我们开发了Quantum-Harbor，一个虚拟实验室，为智能体提供受控的执行环境以与量子系统进行交互。这一设计使得对智能体所采取的行动和所得出的结论都能进行直接验证。基于这一框架，我们提出了QIQCBench，一个包含49个专家编写任务的基准，涵盖多个层次，包括校准与控制、纠错等。
tldr: 该论文开发了提供受控执行环境的虚拟实验室Quantum-Harbor和包含49个专家任务、涵盖校准控制与纠错等多层次的基准QIQCBench，用于系统评估并直接验证AI智能体在自主量子工程中的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Quantum-Harbor, a virtual laboratory providing a controlled execution environment for agents to interact with quantum systems, and QIQCBench, a benchmark of 49 expert-authored tasks spanning calibration, control, and error correction, to systematically evaluate and directly verify the reliability of AI agents in autonomous quantum engineering.
